_comment: Domains that routinely time out or rate-limit under a recursive crawl, but
whose links are not actually broken. A failure on one of these is reported
in log.md under 'Tolerated' and does NOT fail the links check.
This is deliberately different from the `skip` list in the repo-root
linkinator.config.json: skipped links are never requested at all, so they
vanish from the report entirely. Domains listed here ARE still requested
and still listed -- they just don't gate publication.
Matching is on hostname, and covers subdomains: 'archive.org' also matches
tolerateStatuses limits which failures are forgiven, so a listed domain
can still fail the check for a real problem. 0 is a timeout or network
error; 408/429/503 are rate limiting; 403 is bot-blocking. A 404 or 410 is
deliberately NOT in this list -- a missing archive snapshot or a dead
handle is a genuine content error worth fixing, on any domain.
